item.witchsatelier.ink_pen.hint_dip: Dip it in an inkwell (use on a placed one, or hold one in your other hand)
item.witchsatelier.ink_pen.hint_draw: Hold Use on a surface and move your view to draw · sneak to rub out · with paper or a palm quire in the other hand, Use in the air
item.witchsatelier.conjuring_ink.desc: Woodcruor brewed with glowstone. Water washes it away.
item.witchsatelier.invisible_ink.desc: Only you can see what you draw with it.
item.witchsatelier.lasting_ink.desc: Its lines wear far more slowly: rain and passing feet take much longer to break a glyph drawn with it.
item.witchsatelier.blood_ink.desc: Forbidden. Three times the power, far less control.
item.witchsatelier.ink.hint: Pour into an inkwell · sneak + use plain conjuring ink to bleed into it
message.witchsatelier.pen_dry: The pen is dry — dip it in an inkwell or carry one
message.witchsatelier.ring_broken: The ring is broken — the spell fades
message.witchsatelier.no_ring: There is no ring on this page
message.witchsatelier.no_target: Earth magic needs a surface to work on — look at one
item.witchsatelier.inkwell.hint: Hold it in your other hand while drawing, or place it on a desk · click ink bottles onto it to fill it
screen.witchsatelier.page.no_pen: Hold a pen in your other hand to draw
item.witchsatelier.attire.flavor: Wearing it, you feel like a real witch — and that makes you a little stronger.
item.witchsatelier.palm_quire.hint: Use to open · draw with a pen in the other hand · T tears a page out · click paper or crumpled pages onto it to put them in
item.witchsatelier.grimoire.desc: Glyphs drawn long ago in lasting ink. They will not cast from the book; copy them.
glyph.witchsatelier.basics.desc:
A glyph is a ring with a sigil in its middle and signs around it. The sigil is the element; the signs say what it does. Nothing happens until the ring is closed, so witches leave a small gap and close it when they need the spell (V with a page in hand).

A bigger ring is a stronger spell. A glyph keeps working for as long as it is whole: break its ring, rub it out, or let rain and feet wear it away, and it stops. A neat hand wears longer. Signs pointing the wrong way do the opposite. A ring inside a ring shapes the spell within.
glyph.witchsatelier.pillar_of_flame.desc: Fire with four Columns, short bar outward. A column of flame rises from the glyph: it burns what stands in it and lights the way. Drawn on a wall it throws the flame sideways. Add a Convergence to make it narrow and long; a Radial sign tames it into warmth.
glyph.witchsatelier.wind_underfoot.desc: Wind with four Levitation signs. Whatever stands over the glyph is lifted on a steady draught; reversed signs press down instead. Drawn on the soles of shoes, it becomes flight for as long as it is on them: click your heels (jump twice) and fly as in creative, jump to rise and sneak to sink; click them again, or touch the ground, to land. Nothing flies under water, and water washes the glyph off unless its ink is waterproof.
glyph.witchsatelier.birds_of_light.desc: Light with two Birds. Birds made of light fly out of the glyph and circle overhead, a beacon others can see from afar. Each Bird sign is one bird. Drawn with Fire instead, the birds scorch what they touch.
glyph.witchsatelier.beacon_of_birds.desc: Light with Columns and Birds. A beam of light shoots up and birds of light fly out along it. Point it at the sky to call for help, the way witches do when lost.
glyph.witchsatelier.spilling_water.desc: Water with four Dispersions. Water pours out of the glyph all around like an overfull bucket: it floods the ground, puts out fires and washes away ink that is not waterproof.
glyph.witchsatelier.water_jet.desc: Water with four Columns. A hard jet of water: it knocks back what it hits, puts out burning things, fills cauldrons and soaks farmland. Aim it with Direction signs.
glyph.witchsatelier.stone_breaker.desc: Earth with four Crush signs, drawn on stone. The surface under the glyph is ground to rubble. Reversed (Integration) it puts broken stone back together. It needs a surface: from a page, look at the wall you want broken.
glyph.witchsatelier.fire_bolts.desc: Fire with Bolts. A volley of fireballs, one for every Bolt sign, more for a bigger ring. From a page it shoots where you look; a creature under your aim draws the shots.
glyph.witchsatelier.gathering_wind.desc: Wind with four Pulls. Air rushes in towards the glyph and drags things with it. Reversed, it blows them away. Signs turned along the ring make it swirl.
glyph.witchsatelier.rain_of_light.desc: Light with four Rain signs. Soft motes of light fall over the area, lighting it for as long as the glyph holds.
glyph.witchsatelier.lantern.desc: Only Light, no signs. A small steady light stays at the glyph: the first spell every apprentice learns.
glyph.witchsatelier.windowway.desc: The Window sign alone in the ring, no sigil. Draw two of them (on walls, floors or doors) and they join: step into one and come out of the other. A new window joins the last of yours still waiting; joined windows share a rim colour, a waiting one stays dark grey. Make the ring at least two and a half blocks across, or you will not fit.
glyph.witchsatelier.bed_of_sand.desc: A glyph inside a glyph. Inside: Earth with Crush, grinding the stone. Around it, in the band between the rings: Billowing. The ground is broken and everything around it falls soft as on a cloud. Nothing works until the outer ring is closed.
glyph.witchsatelier.everburning_pillar.d: A Pillar of Flame inside a ring of Repetition signs. Repetition keeps setting the glyph back to how it was: rain and feet cannot wear it away, and the flame burns on until a hand breaks the ring.
glyph.witchsatelier.tidal_ring.desc: Spilling Water wrapped in Repetition. The water keeps welling up in rings, and Repetition mends the glyph as fast as anything wears it: a moat, a flood, a fire that will not come back.
glyph.witchsatelier.steam_pillar.desc: A Pillar of Flame with Water and Columns in the band. Fire and water rise together and turn to scalding steam. Any sigil drawn in the band adds its element to the spell inside.
item.witchsatelier.woodcruor_wand.desc: Hardened woodcruor, drawn like chalk. Needs no ink, wears down instead. Its lines are weak and the first rain takes them.
item.witchsatelier.searneedle.desc: Burns its ink into the surface: seared lines shrug off water, fire and lava.
item.witchsatelier.snugstone.desc: Warm without a flame. Carried, it keeps frost away; held, it thaws snow and ice; burns long in a furnace.
item.witchsatelier.vapor_bubble.desc: Pull the trays apart and the air's moisture gathers into water. Pour it out where you point, or into an empty bottle you carry.
item.witchsatelier.light_tracer_bangle.u: Two pieces of one crystal not yet bound. Use the pair to bind them, then give one away.
item.witchsatelier.light_tracer_bangle.b: Hold use: a ribbon of light points to the other pieces of the same crystal.
item.witchsatelier.raincleaver.desc: Countless tiny glyphs on the blade. Swing it at water or lava (use) to open a cleft you can walk through. Sneak and use it on the ground to plant it: no water or lava comes near it while it stands.
item.witchsatelier.mirror_mantle.desc: Crouch and keep still: the mantle borrows the shade around you, and nothing can find you.
glyph.witchsatelier.contraptions.desc: A glyph drawn onto a thing makes the thing do magic by itself: the only way people who are not witches can use magic at all. Some hold their seal for good; most wear out and need a witch to restore them with pen and ink (use a pen with ink on the contraption). Keeping the seals of towers and barrels inked is part of every witch's duties.
A small brick tower with a Beast Repellent seal on hide behind its hatch. While the seal holds, no hostile creature is born within twenty-four blocks, and those that come near are driven back. Restore the seal with a pen and ink every few days, when its hatch goes dark.
glyph.witchsatelier.washing_barrel.desc: A Repetition seal under the lid keeps turning what lies inside back to how it was. Put a worn tool, weapon or garment in and it comes out whole again, slowly. The seal only wears while it is washing something.
Bangles cut from one crystal keep remembering they were one. Bind a pair, give one away, and press the glyph (hold use): a ribbon of light runs out towards the other, however far, as long as it is in the same world.
glyph.witchsatelier.raincleaver.desc: A sword covered in many tiny linked glyphs: many small glyphs joined together are stronger than one big one. It cuts through any liquid. Swing it at water or lava and a passage opens along the stroke, closing again after a while.
glyph.witchsatelier.mirror_mantle.desc: A mantle woven with Mirror and Gathering Shadows. Crouch and keep still, and it borrows the look of the shade around you: you fade from sight and creatures lose you. Move, and the spell breaks.
glyph.witchsatelier.arcane_lens.desc: A great lens from before the Pact. Draw a glyph on it, or right in front of or behind it, and the spell comes out nearly twice as strong as its ring and ink would give.
glyph.witchsatelier.drawing_tools.desc: The ink pen dips into an inkwell in your other hand. A woodcruor wand is a rod of hardened woodcruor used like chalk: no ink needed, but its lines are weak and wash off. A searneedle heats its ink and burns the line into the surface: neither water nor fire can take a seared glyph.
glyph.witchsatelier.sentinel_bolts.desc: Fire with Bolts and a Crosshair. The Crosshair makes the spell turn towards the nearest creature in front of the glyph, hostile ones first: drawn on a wall, it is a sentry that shoots whatever comes.
glyph.witchsatelier.crystal_ward.desc: The Diamond sign alone in the ring. A shell rises over the glyph: arrows and other missiles turn back from it, and hostile creatures are pushed out. Add a Diamond to any glyph to give it a ward.
glyph.witchsatelier.binding_threads.desc: Light with four Weave signs. Threads of light wrap whatever stands in the spell and bind it where it is: it can barely move or strike. Weave adds binding to any spell it is drawn into.
glyph.witchsatelier.puppet_dance.desc: The Dancing Puppet sign alone. Creatures around the glyph forget what they meant to do and dance on strings of the spell. Mischievous, but it has saved more than one witch.
glyph.witchsatelier.gathering_breeze.des: Wind with four Collections. Loose things around (dropped items, motes of experience) drift in and settle on the glyph. With Water instead, it gathers water out of the air.
item.witchsatelier.brimhat_mask.desc: Brimhats take its wearer for one of their own. The Knights Moralis do too.
glyph.witchsatelier.petrification.desc: Forbidden by the Pact. Earth under the gaze of four Eyes. A ball of glowing crystal bursts out of the glyph and swallows everything near it, walls, floors, the very air, with shards standing out all round; every creature inside is a crystal statue. A bigger ring takes more. Only Integration (Earth with reversed Crush) drawn on the crystal gives it all back. The Knights Moralis will know.
advancements.witchsatelier.root.title: Witch's Atelier
advancements.witchsatelier.root.descript: Every witch begins the same way: with a pen.
advancements.witchsatelier.silverwood.de: Find a blackened twig of a silverwood tree.
advancements.witchsatelier.woodcruor.des: Brew woodcruor from a silverwood twig.
advancements.witchsatelier.conjuring_ink: Refine woodcruor into ink that makes seals come alive.
advancements.witchsatelier.first_glyph.d: Close the ring of your first glyph.
advancements.witchsatelier.pillar_of_fla: Raise a column of fire from a glyph.
advancements.witchsatelier.water.title: An Overfull Bucket
advancements.witchsatelier.palm_quire.de: Cast a glyph prepared on a page.
advancements.witchsatelier.birds.title: Birds of Light
advancements.witchsatelier.birds.descrip: Send out birds made of the spell's light.
advancements.witchsatelier.sylph_shoes.d: Click your heels and let the glyph on your soles carry you.
advancements.witchsatelier.nested.title: A Glyph Within a Glyph
advancements.witchsatelier.lens.title: Through the Lense
advancements.witchsatelier.lens.descript: Amplify a glyph with an Arcane Lense.
advancements.witchsatelier.windowway.des: Step through one window and out of another.
advancements.witchsatelier.real_witch.de: Wear the pointed hat of a full witch, and feel like one.
advancements.witchsatelier.stranger.desc: Accept a gift from the stranger in the brimmed hat.
advancements.witchsatelier.contraption.d: Make magic that works for anyone: a warding tower, a washing barrel or a vapor bubble.
advancements.witchsatelier.seared.title: Burned In
advancements.witchsatelier.brimhat.title: The Brimmed Hats
advancements.witchsatelier.mask.title: Behind the Mask
advancements.witchsatelier.forbidden.des: Turn a living thing to stone.
advancements.witchsatelier.integration.d: Bring a statue back to life.
advancements.witchsatelier.knight.title: Order of the Pact
advancements.witchsatelier.knight.descri: Meet the blade of a Knight Moralis.
glyph.witchsatelier.glowstone_path.desc: A paving stone in two halves, the upper one floating on float keystones. Your weight presses them together, the ring closes, and the stone glows under your feet. Lay a path of them through the dark.
glyph.witchsatelier.dragon_teacup.desc: A glyph on the base of the cup, a hidden rune on the saucer. Set the cup down on it and the tea rises in the shape of a little dragon, winding about before it settles. Entirely useless; everyone wants one.
glyph.witchsatelier.forbidden_magic.desc: The Pact forbids magic worked on living bodies, and glyphs that change them: petrification above all. Blood ink is the Brimhats' ink. And no one but a witch may see how magic is made: villagers who watch you draw take fright, think worse of you, and the Pact counts it. Those who break it are found, sooner or later, by the Knights Moralis, and running only brings others. They leave once the debt is paid. A Brimhat mask fools the Brimhats; it fools the knights too, into thinking you are one.
item.witchsatelier.sealchair.desc: A chair on four hoofed legs with a glyph under its seat. Set it down and sit in it: it gets up and walks where you look. Get up and it settles down again. Break it with an axe to take it along.
item.witchsatelier.wingcloak.desc: A flight glyph in its lining. Leap and spread it to glide; a gust of wind carries you up as it opens.
item.witchsatelier.capture_pennant.desc: Point it and the banner streams out and holds whoever it reaches. Silk burns.
item.witchsatelier.tent_staff.desc: Hook it into the ground: the earth rises into a tent around you, and settles back after a while.
glyph.witchsatelier.wingcloak.desc: A cloak with the flight glyph of the sylph shoes in its lining and a second one that keeps rain and dirt off. Leap, spread it and glide; as it opens a gust throws you up and forward. Cloth tears and burns, and so does the glyph with it.
glyph.witchsatelier.tent_staff.desc: Tetia made it so that people who are not witches can camp safely. Hook it into the ground and lift: a layer of soil rises around you into a tent, the staff holding up its middle. It settles back down after a few minutes.
glyph.witchsatelier.capture_pennant.desc: The silver-white banner the Knights Moralis carry. It streams out where it is pointed, winds around whoever it reaches and holds them fast. Richeh freed the captives with a single flame: silk burns.
glyph.witchsatelier.imagined_ring.desc:
No hand draws a true circle by itself. A witch sees the ring first: twice round in the air over the page, the ink not yet touching, and on the third time the pen comes down in one quick stroke.

Go round twice and the ring is laid down true, as big as you circled, with the small gap every witch leaves. Lift the pen sooner and the line goes down as drawn. A ring drawn round just once stays ink; the line lifts into the air only as you start round a second time.

Once read, this stays with you.
advancements.witchsatelier.imagined_ring: Read how witches see a ring before they draw it.
glyph.witchsatelier.snare_of_flame.desc:
Fire with three Columns and a Tread, the sign like a little stair. Closed, the glyph wakes but holds its fire: the pillar bursts up only when a creature steps onto it. Its maker can walk over it safely.

Tread holds back any glyph this way. Drawn in invisible ink, nobody sees the snare before it springs.
glyph.witchsatelier.pillar_and_volley.de: Fire with two Columns and two Bolts. Two ways of shaping in one ring work side by side: the flame rises as a pillar and throws fireballs at the same time. Any shaping sign drawn twice joins the one that leads; one stray sign alone does nothing.
glyph.witchsatelier.earthen_wall.desc: Earth with four Dispersions, drawn on the ground. The earth heaves up round the glyph in a ring, a little higher each moment, and stands as a wall for as long as the spell holds. A bigger ring raises it higher.
glyph.witchsatelier.rising_earth.desc: Earth with four Levitation signs, drawn on the ground. The ground under the glyph rises as a platform, carrying whoever stands on it up with it. When the spell ends the earth sinks back and its riders drift down softly.
glyph.witchsatelier.mire.desc: Earth with four Pulls. The ground round the glyph goes soft and drags at every foot: creatures crossing it wade as if through mud. Reversed, the ground firms and pushes back instead.
glyph.witchsatelier.quickening_soil.desc: Only Earth, no signs. The soil around the glyph wakes: crops, saplings and flowers nearby grow much faster for as long as the glyph holds. The first spell of every farming village.
glyph.witchsatelier.sunlit_spill.desc: Light with four Dispersions. Light pours out all round like sun through a door: creatures in it glow, and the dead burn in it as they burn under the sun.
glyph.witchsatelier.linked_glyphs.desc:
Glyphs joined by a line of ink are one work. Draw a line from the rim of one ring to the rim of another, and when one wakes, every glyph joined to it wakes with it, even one whose own ring was left open.

Many small glyphs joined are stronger than one big one: each glyph in the chain makes all the others stronger. The Raincleaver's blade is covered in them.
item.witchsatelier.grimoire.hint: Hold it with a pen in the other hand: the page's glyph shows faintly where you look · scroll to size it · Shift to pin it, then trace it: a faithful copy casts as the page's glyph
glyph.witchsatelier.fan_of_flame.desc: Fire with four Direction signs, all pointing out. A Direction sign tells the element which way to go: all pointing the same way along the surface, the spell goes that way; pointing out all round, it fans wide; pointing in, it draws to a point.
glyph.witchsatelier.lance_of_light.desc: Light with three Columns and a Convergence. Convergence gathers a spell into a narrow, far-reaching line: here a lance of light that burns the dead and lights a path a long way off.
glyph.witchsatelier.great_lantern.desc: A Lantern inside a ring of Enlarge signs. Enlarge, drawn in the band of a nested glyph, makes the spell inside it stronger: each one more, up to three.
glyph.witchsatelier.night_eye.desc: The Vision sign alone in the ring. Whoever stands by the glyph sees in the dark as by day.
glyph.witchsatelier.veil_of_unseeing.des: Vision in the middle, ringed with four Bends. Bend turns sight aside: those by the glyph cannot be seen. Bend and Eye hide any glyph's working this way.
glyph.witchsatelier.feather_fall.desc: Wind with four Float signs. Float is the gentle sister of Levitation: it does not throw you up, it holds you so you sink slowly and land soft.
glyph.witchsatelier.warming_hearth.desc: Fire with four Radial signs. Radial tames fire into warmth: no flame catches, but snow and ice around it melt. Add it to any fire glyph to make it gentle.
glyph.witchsatelier.sylph_step.desc: The sigil of the wind underfoot alone: the sigil of sylph shoes. Standing on it you leap higher and fall softly.
glyph.witchsatelier.breath_of_the_deep.d: The sigil of airy forms alone. Whoever stands by it can breathe under water for as long as it holds.
jei.witchsatelier.info.ink_pen: Draw a ring with a sigil in its middle and signs around it, then close the ring: the glyph wakes. The grimoires found in ruins and libraries show what to draw.
jei.witchsatelier.info.grimoire: Every book is its own, on one theme: fire, water, earth, wind, light, nested glyphs or uncommon signs. The Stranger gives a primer and sells others; the rest are found in library ruins, along with loose pages of single glyphs, the rare notes on the imagined ring, and the black-bound book of what the Pact forbids.
jei.witchsatelier.info.woodcruor: Brewed in a brewing stand: a blackened silverwood twig in a water bottle gives woodcruor; woodcruor with glowstone dust gives conjuring ink.
message.witchsatelier.trace_follow: The page's glyph shows where you look · scroll to size it · Shift to pin it
message.witchsatelier.trace_pinned: Pinned · trace it with the pen: a faithful copy casts as the page's glyph
message.witchsatelier.dormant: It is still dormant. Hold a pen in the other hand and draw its glyph on it.
tooltip.witchsatelier.dormant: Dormant: hold a pen in the other hand, use it in the air, and trace the glyph shown on it.
message.witchsatelier.barrel.not_worn: Only worn things are washed whole again: a damaged tool, weapon or garment.
message.witchsatelier.barrel.empty: Put a worn tool, weapon or garment in, and leave it to wash.
message.witchsatelier.barrel.faded: Its seal has faded. Restore it with an inked pen.
item.witchsatelier.glowstone_path.desc: Lay it in a path and walk over it: your weight presses the halves together and it glows under your feet, and a little after.
item.witchsatelier.washing_barrel.desc: Put a worn tool, weapon or garment in: it comes out whole again, slowly. Take it out with an empty hand. Re-ink the seal with a pen when it fades.
item.witchsatelier.beast_warding_tower.d: While its seal holds, no hostile creature spawns within 24 blocks. Re-ink the seal with a pen when it fades.
item.witchsatelier.void_basin.desc: Whatever falls in is gone. Jump in yourself, and you fall among the stars; draw any glyph there to find your way back.
item.witchsatelier.arcane_lens.desc: Draw a glyph on it, or right in front of or behind it: the spell comes out nearly twice as strong.
item.witchsatelier.dragon_teacup.desc: Set it down and use it: the tea rises in the shape of a little dragon.
jei.witchsatelier.awakening.how: Draw this glyph on the dormant artifact: the artifact in one hand, a loaded pen in the other. The glyph shows faintly on it to be traced; close the ring and the artifact wakes.
jei.witchsatelier.info.awakening: The crafting table makes it dormant. Draw its glyph on it to wake it: see Awakening.
jei.witchsatelier.info.blackened_silverw: Now and then found when a silverwood log is broken. Brewed in a water bottle, it gives woodcruor.
jei.witchsatelier.info.torn_page: What is left of a page torn out of the Palm Quire, glyph and all. Put it back into the quire to bind it in again.
jei.witchsatelier.info.brimhat_mantle: Rarely left behind by a Brimhat struck down.
jei.witchsatelier.info.brimhat_mask: Now and then left behind by a Brimhat struck down.
jei.witchsatelier.info.capture_pennant: Rarely dropped by the Knights Moralis.
glyph.witchsatelier.the_pact.desc: Once, anyone with ink and a pen could work magic, and some worked terrible things with it. On the Day of the Pact the witches took the knowledge from everyone else and swore to keep it among themselves. Since then the world believes magic is a gift one is born with. It is not: it is drawing, and that is the secret every witch keeps.
glyph.witchsatelier.blood_ink.desc: Conjuring ink with the drawer's own blood bled into it. A glyph drawn with it is three times as strong, and far harder to hold: it misfires, and every stroke is counted against you by the Pact. The Brimhats draw with nothing else.
glyph.witchsatelier.brimhats.desc: Witches who never accepted the Pact. They hide their faces under brimmed hats and masks, draw in blood ink, and work the magic the Pact forbids, on creatures and on people. They teach it to anyone who will listen. Wear one of their masks and they will take you for one of them.
glyph.witchsatelier.knights_moralis.desc: The order that keeps the Pact. They come for whoever works forbidden magic or shows magic being made to those who must not see it. Running does not help: others are sent from wherever you are now. They bind with a silver-white pennant and a ring of light, and they leave once the debt is paid.
item.witchsatelier.witch_grimoire.desc: A book of your own. Draw your glyphs in it with a pen, name each page and write your notes beside it. It keeps glyphs to copy and trace from; they do not cast from it.
item.witchsatelier.witch_grimoire.hint: Use to open · draw with a pen in the other hand, right-drag to rub out · sneak + use on a glyph to copy it in, or with an old grimoire in the other hand to copy its open page · craft it with blank ones to copy it
screen.witchsatelier.grimoire.title: Page name
message.witchsatelier.grimoire.full: Every page is already drawn on
jei.witchsatelier.info.witch_grimoire: Craft a blank one from a book, conjuring ink and a feather. Put a written one in the crafting grid with blank ones to copy it into them; the original stays.
item.witchsatelier.glyph_arrow.desc: An arrow wrapped in a page with a glyph on it. Where it strikes the glyph is cast as if drawn there: on the face of the block it hits, or on the ground under whoever it hits. The strike closes a ring left open. With no ink there to keep it, the spell lasts ten seconds at most.
item.witchsatelier.glyph_arrow.hint: Craft an arrow with paper or a torn page that has a glyph on it · shoot it from a bow, a crossbow or a dispenser
jei.witchsatelier.info.glyph_arrow: Craft an arrow with a sheet of paper or a torn page that has a glyph on it. A dispenser shoots glyph arrows, and given a page with a glyph it casts the glyph from its own front, burning the page.
